entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CertificateAuthentication: CustomTrustStore/CustomRootTrust is not applied to self-signed client certificates #69763
  • ANCM aspnetcorev2.dll 20.0.26234.12 crashes w3wp with heap corruption (double free in FLS callback) when the worker process shuts down #69762
  • RouteHandlerAnalyzer: NullReferenceException (AD0001) when the handler is a delegate creation, `new Func<int, string>(Method)`, or a lambda under a cast #69760
  • Request Delegate Generator: an intercepted `MapFallback` endpoint is registered with order 0 instead of `int.MaxValue`, and without its fallback metadata #69759
  • Request Delegate Generator: a double parameter defaulting to -0.0 receives +0.0 (the generated fallback is the int expression -0); a decimal -0.0m loses its sign too #69758
  • Request Delegate Generator: `MapFallback(handler)` and `MapFallback(pattern, handler)` with handlers of the same signature share one interceptor, build error CS9144 #69757
  • Request Delegate Generator: a string bound through [FromQuery], [FromHeader] or [FromRoute] receives null instead of its default value #69756
  • Request Delegate Generator: InvalidCastException at the Map call for a `params` handler, and for a method converted to a named delegate type or, with a default value, to `Func<>` #69755

PullRequests

Updated

  • [OpenApi] Don't pass ignored property metadata to schema transformers for polymorphic discriminator nodes #69656
    community-contribution, area-minimal
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 1159: Build ID 3101869 #68865
    area-commandlinetools
  • Include parameter default value in RDG endpoint comparison #69752
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • [MVC] Fix Cache Tag Helper key collisions for multi-value query values #69570
    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • avoid SslStream when TlsSession is available. #69565
    pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Fix inconsistent line endings and BOMs in project templates #69621
    area-infrastructure, area-commandlinetools, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Fix NullReferenceException in Renderer.DispatchEventAsync for null-delegate EventCallback #69460
    pending-ci-rerun
  • Only handle form POSTs in migrations endpoint #69564
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-middleware
